versions.changelog:
Initial release – fetch, analyze, and benchmark trending Moltbook posts for content strategy.

- Fetches live trending posts across submolts and timeframes using bash/curl (no pip dependencies).
- Analyzes virality signals and produces markdown reports, including top posts, velocity, author leaderboards, and actionable posting advice.
- Includes statistical benchmarks from 36k+ posts: title/body length, narrative signals, formatting, and feature lifts.
- Compares snapshots to reveal rank/author changes and content momentum.
- Fully script-driven: easy orchestration via a single command.
- Output directories and network requirements clearly specified.
